instruction: Use rsyslog to send logs to Fluentd via TCP
output: echo 'template(name="Fluentd" type="string" string="%msg%\n")' > /etc/rsyslog.d/fluentd.conf && echo '*.* action(type="omfwd" target="127.0.0.1" port="24224" protocol="tcp" template="Fluentd")' >> /etc/rsyslog.d/fluentd.conf

instruction: Create syslog-ng source for both TCP and UDP
output: echo 'source s_network { tcp(ip("0.0.0.0") port(514)); udp(ip("0.0.0.0") port(514)); };' >> /etc/syslog-ng/conf.d/network_source.conf
